name: Tides (Queensland)
author: StevenFay
description: Tide times for a Queensland beach: animated water level, today's highs and lows, a 24-hour chart and moon/tide stats. Maritime Safety Queensland predictions from data.qld.gov.au, with a time and height correction for beaches between gauges. Set up for Woodgate Beach.

versions.notes: First release, based on ChuckBuilds' tide-display 1.3.5 (ledmatrix-plugins d43e302). NOAA is replaced by Maritime Safety Queensland's predicted high/low waters (data.qld.gov.au), downloaded once per year and kept on the Pi; the curve between highs and lows is a half cosine. Site time and height corrections, metres and AEST by default, display modes tides_current / tides_schedule / tides_chart / tides_stats so it can run beside Tide Display. Burnett Heads 2026 is bundled.
